limitations: Retrieved text is represented by accurate paraphrases, not a full-page archive.
Live pages and search indexing can be stale; no verified internal build, completion, certification or gold milestone was found.
Two Newswire article opens returned zero extractable lines; the official product page and Take-Two releases supplied accessible corroboration.
Rockstar, its parent Take-Two, and storefronts may share one publisher schedule; agreement is not independent multiplication of evidence.
Costs and model calls are unmetered. Workflow numeric zero counters mean unreported usage, not zero cost.
No calibrated delay reference class was fitted; weights and milestone timings are subjective judgments.
